description:
Long-Range Power with Full-Suspension Comfort

The Kornorge TB20 Electric Bike is designed for riders who want stronger everyday performance and significantly longer riding range. Its 1500W motor provides responsive acceleration and speeds of up to 35 mph, while the high-capacity removable 48V 25Ah battery supports up to 124 miles of pedal-assist range under ideal riding conditions.

Full suspension, hydraulic disc brakes, 20 × 4.0 inch anti-puncture fat tires, and a Shimano 7-speed drivetrain help provide a stable and controlled riding experience across city streets, gravel, hills, and other mixed surfaces. Smart App connectivity and NFC unlocking add extra convenience for everyday use.

Why Choose the Kornorge TB20 Electric Bike?

1500W Motor
The high-performance motor delivers responsive acceleration and speeds of up to 35 mph for commuting, recreational riding, and more demanding everyday routes.

48V 25Ah Removable Battery
The high-capacity removable lithium-ion battery provides extended riding capability and convenient charging at home or at work.

Up to 124 Miles of Pedal-Assist Range
The TB20 is designed for longer journeys, supporting up to 124 miles of pedal-assist range under ideal riding conditions.

Full-Suspension Comfort
Front and rear suspension help absorb road vibration and impacts, improving comfort and stability across pavement and uneven terrain.

Hydraulic Disc Brakes
Front and rear hydraulic disc brakes provide strong, responsive, and consistent stopping power for city riding, hills, and higher-speed travel.

20 × 4.0 Inch Anti-Puncture Fat Tires
Wide fat tires provide a larger contact patch for improved grip, balance, and confidence across pavement, gravel, sand, snow, and other mixed surfaces.

Shimano 7-Speed Drivetrain
The Shimano 7-speed drivetrain provides smooth mechanical shifting and greater flexibility across different speeds, gradients, and riding conditions.

Smart App & NFC Connectivity
Compatible smart App features and NFC support add convenient ride management and bike access functions for everyday use.

Upgraded LCD Display
The detachable LCD display provides clear access to important riding information, including speed, battery status, distance, and assistance level.

Who Is the Kornorge TB20 Electric Bike For?

Long-Distance Commuters
The 48V 25Ah battery and extended pedal-assist range make the TB20 a strong option for riders who regularly travel longer distances.

Riders Seeking More Power
The 1500W motor provides stronger acceleration and higher-speed capability than a typical entry-level commuter e-bike.

Comfort-Focused Riders
Full suspension, wide fat tires, and an extended saddle help create a smoother and more stable riding experience across longer journeys.

Mixed-Terrain Riders
The wide tires, suspension system, and hydraulic brakes provide added confidence across city streets, gravel roads, park trails, sand, and other mixed surfaces.

Tech-Focused Riders
Smart App connectivity and NFC functionality add convenient digital control and access features for riders who value connected functionality.

Maximum Range
Up to 124 Miles in Pedal-Assist Mode

Maximum Speed
Up to 35 mph, Where Local Regulations Permit

Tire Size
20 × 4.0 Inch Anti-Puncture Fat Tires

Net Weight
100 lb / 45.4 kg, Including Battery

Maximum speed, range, climbing ability, and other performance figures are based on manufacturer specifications and testing. Actual performance may vary depending on rider weight, assistance level, terrain, weather, temperature, tire pressure, battery condition, and riding conditions. Always follow applicable local e-bike laws and regulations.
